faqs.question: How do solar panels work?
faqs.answer: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity using photovoltaic (PV) cells. When sunlight hits the panels, it generates direct current (DC) electricity, which is then converted into usable alternating current (AC) for your home or business.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of installing solar panels?
faqs.answer: Installing solar panels lowers electricity bills, provides clean renewable energy, reduces carbon emissions, increases property value, and offers protection against rising utility tariffs.

faqs.question: How much can I save with solar energy?
faqs.answer: Depending on your electricity usage, roof size, and location, most homeowners and businesses save between 60% to 90% on their ongoing monthly power bills.

faqs.question: How long does the installation process take?
faqs.answer: Residential installations typically take 2-5 days once permits and site approvals are cleared, while larger commercial projects take 1 to 3 weeks depending on the system size.

faqs.question: Do solar panels require a lof maiot ntenance?
faqs.answer: No, solar panels require minimal maintenance. Occasional cleaning with water to remove dust and debris along with an annual routine check is generally all that is needed.

defaultService.tagline: A smarter energy solution that combines the power of wind and solar to ensure continuous, reliable and clean electricity for your home or business.
defaultService.description: Hybrid wind and solar systems use both solar panels and wind turbines to generate electricity. When the sun isn't shining, wind power helps keep your system running. This combination provides a stable and efficient energy supply throughout the year, even in changing weather conditions, making it a perfect choice for areas with variable sunlight and consistent wind.
